What our elders say

Oral history
"In our time there was no electricity till late in the evening. We studied by the light of a kerosene lamp, and still no one in our house failed an exam."
Kunjukrishnan Nair, 82 — farmer, Chammanur
"The pond near the temple never dried up, even in the worst summers. My grandmother used to say the land itself was blessed by the goddess."
Devaki Amma, 76 — homemaker, Punnayoorkulam
"We walked four miles to the nearest school. Nobody complained — that was simply how it was done, and we were glad to be going at all."
Raghavan Master, 79 — retired schoolteacher

About

R

I build front-end interfaces and freelance on custom ecommerce and non-ecommerce sites. Before that I taught higher secondary students, tested software at Manappuram, and interned across PHP and .NET stacks — a fairly winding way to end up writing HTML for a living.

I hold an MCA from Vidya Engineering College and a BCA from Calicut University. These days most of my work happens for clients, and this notebook is where the leftover thinking goes. Get in touch if you'd like to work together.

Have a project, or just a question?

I take on a small number of freelance builds at a time. The fastest way to reach me is email.
